title: Act: Move backend/game to top-level game/
summary: git mv the runtime module to game/
description: Context: backend/game holds the full TypeScript runtime. Desired behavior: move it wholesale so relative imports stay valid. Expected result: game/ contains every former file and backend/game is gone. Why: top-level module layout.
acceptance_criteria: Given the repo root, when running git mv backend/game game, then game/src and game/content exist
Given the move, when checking backend/game, then it is absent

steps.action: From the repo root run git mv backend/game game so every tracked file (src, content, tests, package.json, package-lock.json, tsconfig.json, vitest.config.ts) moves with its history; do not edit contents because all imports are relative (../src/..., ../content/...).
steps.expected: ls game shows src content tests package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts; ls backend shows no game directory

steps.action: Confirm the moved world.yaml and scenes/bedroom.yaml are at game/content/worlds/the-boys-room/ unchanged, which is the path content.test.ts resolves via resolve(__dirname, '../content/worlds/the-boys-room').
steps.expected: git status shows renames (R) only, no content modifications
